name: power-automate-monitoring
description: Pro+ subscription required. Tenant-wide Power Automate monitoring using the FlowStudio MCP cached store: failure rates, run-health trends, maker/app inventory, inactive owners, and compliance/health reports. Use only for aggregated tenant views. For one environment, one flow, run control, or root-cause debugging, use power-automate-mcp, power-automate-debug, or the server monitor-flow bundle. Requires FlowStudio for Teams or MCP Pro+.
